contentPattern.structure: tab labels (All + categories) + per-tab adventure card grid (image-top + title + description)

suitableFor: tabbed category filters over a set of listing items
grouping a card grid under user-selectable category tabs
listing pages where items are filtered by type/category via tabs
notSuitableFor: a single flat card grid with no tabs (use cards-article)

usage.note: Created for the adventures page 'Current Adventures' tabbed category filter (All/Climbing/Cycling/Skiing/Surfing/Travel). Based on the Block Collection tabs block but made DA-compatible: imports only from ../../scripts/aem.js (no moveInstrumentation / scripts.js), all classes renamed to the tabs-adventures-* namespace. Card-grid layout for the per-panel adventures handled in CSS.
